amenitiesDescription:
Over 40,000 square feet of interior and exterior amenities span the ground level, third floor, and rooftop — designed by RDAI with the same rigor brought to every residence. The 70-foot rooftop pool overlooks the Intracoastal Waterway and South Beach, surrounded by approximately 15,300 square feet of resident-exclusive outdoor space including shaded seating areas, four cabanas, and an outdoor shower deck. A full wellness suite encompasses a fitness center, private training studio, yoga and Pilates room, sauna, steam room, cold plunge, jacuzzi, and dedicated men's and women's spas with locker rooms.

Social spaces include a golf simulator and screening room, lounge and party room, meeting room, children's playroom, entertaining suite, executive lounge, serenity lounge — each with adjacent terraces — plus a catering kitchen, garden and courtyard, and salon suite for à la carte services. Fouquet's brings five distinct dining and bar concepts in-building, including a patisserie, alongside full residential management: owners receive the same bespoke concierge, housekeeping, pantry stocking, chauffeur, and lifestyle programming extended to hotel guests.

hotelDescription: Fouquet's has defined Parisian luxury since 1899, when it first opened on the Champs-Élysées. Part of the Barrière group, the brand operates acclaimed hotels from Tribeca to Gustavia to Courchevel. Miami marks its second U.S. property — fully integrated within the residential tower, with owners receiving the same bespoke attention extended to hotel guests: five distinct dining concepts, curated programming, and day-to-day lifestyle management.
hotelQuote: The creative sophistication of the Design District perfectly complements our ultra-luxury destinations from Tribeca and Gustavia to Courchevel and the Champs-Élysées. By marrying our deep heritage with David Chipperfield's architectural vision, we look forward to delivering Fouquet's signature art de vivre to both residents and guests.

investmentThesis: Developed by a partnership of Raycliff Capital, Fort Partners, Miami Design District Associates (Dacra / L Catterton / Brookfield), and Constellation Hotels Holding — four institutions with combined track records spanning global luxury hospitality, design district curation, and high-end residential development. The Design District's position as Miami's premier luxury retail and cultural destination (home to Louis Vuitton, Dior, Chanel, ICA Miami) underpins long-term value. Fouquet's — the legendary Champs-Elysees brasserie — brings a Parisian hospitality brand to its first U.S. address. The 40% pre-closing deposit structure (10% signing, 10% at 90 days, 10% groundbreaking, 10% top-off, 60% closing) is competitive for a project of this caliber. Sales launched March 2026; estimated completion 2030.
name: Miami Design Residences by Fouquet's
pressHeadline: Fouquet's Is Opening a Luxe New Hotel in the Buzzy Design District
residenceContent: The Design District's first residential development and the only Florida project by 2023 Pritzker Prize laureate Sir David Chipperfield. The tower rises on nearly two acres at 39 NE 39th Street, its colonnade arrival sequence, glass and mineral cladding, and champagne-colored mullions calibrated to Miami's shifting light. Interiors by Parisian studio RDAI bring warmth and precision in equal measure — custom oak and lacquered wood cabinetry, Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, and floor-to-ceiling hurricane-rated windows throughout. An 85-key Fouquet's hotel connects to the residential tower, providing residents with Paris-standard hospitality services, priority restaurant access, and a seamless blend of private living and hotel amenity. Landscape by Perry Guillot Inc.
